status: registered before the first match; development measurement, NOT a formal acceptance and NOT a G-A8 result
authority: Owner review of the balance study: confirm the effect on choices and exclusion rows, keep added testing small; same rules as Owner 2026-11-01 item 5 and Owner 2026-10-13
question: Which choices should be offered on classic.m6 / v2.hard_engage_stack / v2.three_lane_pressure under template table v21.b2? classic.m3 / m7 / m8 keep their v21.b1 evidence: their values are identical in both tables, checked by check_stage1_split_3aB S3b

scope.selectionRule: mechanical, from code, no results seen: every live (dimension, choice) structurally offered on the template under v21.b2 and not covered by an unscoped template "*" row, with at least one of: A an existing row keyed to that template; B the weak batch of the current truth plan; C the smallest knob delta among non-std templates under v21.b2 (same formula as the truth plan) falling only on these three templates (classic.m6, v2.hard_engage_stack, v2.three_lane_pressure) (a tie with a template outside the table means own, claim and delta did not move, so the shipped evidence stands; anything that moved is caught by E); D newly offered under v21.b2 compared to the shipped config; E the table changed its own choice, its claim or its knob delta compared to the shipped config. A selected choice with no registered claim (own null, for example classic.m3 teamfight.posture) is not run and is decided no_claim
scope.outOfScope: "*" rows: std-level decisions (n=400 replication or std primary rows), unchanged by a template fix. classic.m7 lanes.top.stance=split and classic.m8 phases.late.objectiveOrder=baron are keyed rows also covered by a "*" not_replicated row, so they stay withheld whatever this study would say and are not measured
scope.winCondition: an ordinary row of this rule. Exclusion rows feed winConditionFill (tacticChoiceMapping.js), so a saved plan with a win condition may expand differently under v21.b2 once rows change; this only affects career.v21, is pinned by the regression after the rows are applied, and is listed in the result report

seeds.note: fresh block, unused by any study; scan 2026-11-03: only three literals inside the July H.2 scattered sample on an old engine

design: same as truth-table weak batches: blue = the template with the choice, red = std, control = the template with no choice on the same seed, mirrored roster, items standard, skills on; blue arm only (red replication is out of scope for a development study)

decisionRule.authority: Owner 2026-10-13: keep the original measurement and acceptance rule, do NOT just switch to z >= 3; marginal choices are re-verified with independent fresh seeds, blue and red; insufficient evidence may not be labelled live
decisionRule.metricAndDirection: the registered claim of the row given the template's own choice under v21.b2 (claimFor), never chosen after seeing data

stage1.pass: paired z >= 3 in the claimed direction with n >= 20: offered
stage1.reversed: z against the direction <= -2: withheld, reason reversed_effect
stage1.unmeasurable: n < 20 or z null: withheld, reason unmeasurable
stage1.noClaim: no registered claim: withheld, reason unmeasurable; a metric is never invented
stage1.sameAs: TRUTH_GATE: minZ 2, marginalBelowZ 3, verdict labels of check_tactic_truth_3a

stage2.design: only the stage-1 marginal rows, each with blue and red arms against std, controls per side and per template, run after the stage-1 result is committed
stage2.confirmed: on BOTH sides z >= 3 and relative effect >= 0.05 in the claimed direction: offered. The replication rule of tactic_followup_3a_replication.json
stage2.honesty: pre-freeze: a development confirmation. It does not replace the post-freeze step 4b

decisionRule.noRetries: no re-run, no seed swap, no metric swap, no seed dropped. errorRule: any errored match means no verdict at all (undecided, reported to the Owner); more than 1% is a STOP

application.order: report first; the rows are applied in a later commit from the result file
application.existingKeyedRow: every existing classic.m6 / v2.hard_engage_stack / v2.three_lane_pressure row in this study gets templateBalance null: it keeps withholding on the shipped config exactly as today (v20 and every table-less path) and stops applying under v21.b2. If the choice is not offered by this study, a new row keyed "v21.b2" carries this study's reason, metric, n and z
application.newRows: every other selected choice not offered by this study gets a new row keyed "v21.b2"
application.offered: pass, or stage-2 confirmed: no row under v21.b2; the post-freeze confirmation (formal acceptance step 4b) still has to pass
application.v20: the v20 offer lists, check_match_setup_3a (v20 golden 39 cases) and the Challenge goldens stay byte-identical, verified by those gates and check_stage1_split_3aB S13
application.gatesThatChange: check_stage1_split_3aB S13 (it pins that no row is keyed), check_tactic_registry_3a and check_tactic_book_view_3a if they count rows: replacement assertions registered before editing

limits: multiple comparisons are not corrected. Stage 1 is blue only, the same as the truth-table weak batches. Options offered today can be withdrawn; every one is listed for the Owner
expectedEffort: stage 1: 400 matches, about 10 minutes, single line, workers 3; stage 2 only if the one measured row is marginal: 1,600 matches, about 35 minutes
reportListings: the stage-1 report prints every option offered today that the study does not offer. Applying the rows also lists every win-condition expansion that changes on classic.m6 / v2.hard_engage_stack / v2.three_lane_pressure (before / after of winConditionFill) in the stage-1 doc
ownerVisibleConsequence: classic.m6 teamfight.posture: passive, standard and aggressive are selected with no registered claim (own null), so the rule withdraws them under v21.b2, exactly as for classic.m3. v2.hard_engage_stack and v2.three_lane_pressure keep aggression, so no knob delta moves and no row is selected. risk.tolerance=balanced becomes their own value on all three, so it stops being a non-default choice. Other templates: 0 cells of 588 move between v21.b1 and v21.b2
